strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-beta names and liquid sector ETFs. Rides relative strength with trailing stops; cuts losers fast. Aggressive sizing inside hard guardrails — paper only.
rules: Enter on breakout, momentum, oversold snapback, or dated catalyst (2+ signals preferred).
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), NEUTRAL-trimmed −25%, capped at 30% of equity per name.
Initial stop below pivot; 18% trailing stop on all entries.
Take partial profit at +6–8%; let remainder trail with tightened stop.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; flatten at −25% MTD.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16–24): trim new sizes 25%, be choosier.
